title: Hidden Agent Exposed
next_chapter_hook: The blood flowing from the traitor's mouth dyed the floor of the interrogation room crimson, yet his laughter grew increasingly mad——that laughter echoed in Chen Ji's ears, as if mocking the entire chess game of the mortal realm.

text.content: The faint light flickering from the turtle shell fragment pulsed in Chen Ji's palm, an ancient and dangerous warning. He raised his gaze toward the western suburbs of the imperial capital, his pupils contracting sharply. The approaching presence carried a familiarity that chilled him to the bone——it was the aura of an old acquaintance, yet threaded with some indescribable strangeness. "Su Qingyao." He murmured softly, his voice terrifyingly calm, as if the dead silence before a storm.

Before the words faded, a cyan figure glided through the courtyard like a startled swan, precisely Su Qingyao. Her expression was colder than ever before, her brow creased with impenetrable gloom, clutching a stack of blood-stained interrogation documents. "Chen Ji." She halted three steps away, her voice trembling slightly, "Something's happened. Within the Xuanwu... someone leaked all our observers' names to the old powers."

Chen Ji said nothing, merely gazing silently at the stack of documents in her hands. His silence was more suffocating than any interrogation, the air seemingly frozen into ice. Su Qingyao drew a deep breath and extended the documents: "The core member of the Black Xuanwu, the one codenamed 'Shadow'——is Qin Wujiu. He was a man we nurtured ourselves, the one you personally rescued from the ruins in Chapter 320."

dialogue.content: "Three months ago, that assassination attempt cost the Xuanwu seven elite spies——I thought it was merely precise enemy intelligence." Su Qingyao's fingertips had gone pale, "Until I intercepted this transmission jade slip last night. It contains detailed records of all observers' lurking positions, movement patterns, even..." She paused, her voice hoarse, "Even the energy fluctuation signature when you use the Tianji Record."

text.content: Chen Ji took the jade slip, his divine sense probing within. His expression remained placid as still water, as if he'd heard nothing more than an inconsequential remark. But Su Qingyao noticed his knuckles gripping the jade slip had turned white, veins throbbing beneath the skin. This was the first time in her acquaintance with Chen Ji that she had seen him lose composure to such a degree. Rage churned beneath the surface of calm, like magma surging underground.

Qin Wujiu. This name reverberated through Chen Ji's mind, carrying a bitter irony. Chapter 320, in the ruins, that youth abandoned by his companions, grievously wounded yet with stubborn eyes still bright. He had personally healed his wounds, personally inserted him into Xuanwu's core, personally given him everything. And now, this name had become synonymous with betrayal.

choice.prompt: Facing this sudden betrayal, Chen Ji must make a decision. Anger is inevitable, but how to handle this matter will affect the subsequent situation.

choices.description: Traitors must pay the price, to warn all those with treacherous intentions.

text.content: Chen Ji clasped the jade slip in his palm and calmly uttered a single word: "Investigate." This word was brief and icy, yet carried undeniable resolve. Su Qingyao felt a chill climb her spine——she knew that when Chen Ji spoke in such a tone, it meant there was no room for negotiation. Qin Wujiu's life had already been sentenced.

choices.text: Give Him a Chance to Redeem Himself

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then suddenly laughed lightly: "Interesting." Su Qingyao frowned, "Can you still laugh at a time like this?" "That's precisely why I want to laugh." Chen Ji tossed the jade slip to her, "Have someone bring Qin Wujiu here. I want to ask him a few questions personally. If there's truly a hidden truth, I'd like to see who pushed him to this point." His gaze was chilling to the bone.

text.content: Chen Ji turned and walked toward the window, his back to Su Qingyao. "Continue feeding him intelligence." His voice was soft, yet carried a chilling certainty, "But from now on, what content gets transmitted will be decided by us. Su Qingyao, within three days, I want to know who lies at the other end of this line." He glanced back, a sharp gleam flickering in his eyes.

Just then, a baleful presence stealthily drew near. The lanterns in the courtyard trembled without wind, and Ye Qing's figure emerged from the shadows, her expression more grim than usual. "Chen Ji." Her voice was low, "I've found out something about that external enemy raid in Chapter 442." She paused, her gaze sweeping over Su Qingyao, "The Xuanwu's losses were no accident. From beginning to end, it was an elaborately staged performance."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing hurled a token stained with black blood onto the table. "This was found in Qin Wujiu's secret chamber." A flash of fury flickered deep in her eyes, "A Holy Sect token. But what's interesting is that the contact cipher inscribed on this token..." She looked at Chen Ji, "Matches the same group that raided our camp on the night of Chapter 442. In other words, from the very beginning, the Xuanwu's core had already been infiltrated."

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his gaze to the token, his fingertips gently stroking the patterns upon it. His expression betrayed neither joy nor anger, yet that intangible pressure forced even Ye Qing to retreat half a step. After a long silence, he spoke, his voice terrifyingly calm: "Where is Qin Wujiu now?" Su Qingyao replied: "Already restrained, locked in the Xuanwu dungeon." Chen Ji rose and straightened his sleeves. "Take me to him."

The Xuanwu dungeon was cold and damp, the air thick with the stench of blood and decay. Qin Wujiu hung chained to the wall, those once-stubborn bright eyes now dim and lifeless, reflecting the flickering torches. When he saw Chen Ji approaching, he actually managed a诡异的 smile at the corners of his mouth: "You've finally come, Observer." His voice was hoarse, yet carried a sort of sick satisfaction. "I've waited for this day... far too long."

choice.prompt: Qin Wujiu's attitude was unexpected—he seemed unafraid of the impending judgment, even carrying a strange anticipation. Chen Ji needs to respond.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji said nothing, merely walking forward slowly. With each step, the spiritual pressure around him grew heavier, like a solidified mountain pressing down. Qin Wujiu's smile finally froze, his spine beginning to bend, cold sweat beading at his temples. But Chen Ji still didn't stop, until he stood before Qin Wujiu, looking down at him from above. "Finished?" He asked softly, his voice carrying no anger whatsoever, only a despair-inducing calm.

text.content: Qin Wujiu's pupils contracted sharply. He opened his mouth to speak, yet discovered his voice had been completely sealed by that oppressive presence. Chen Ji's calm was more terrifying than any rage, for it signified absolute control.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that smile gentle enough to send chills. "Waited too long?" He softly repeated these words, his tone as if discussing the weather, "Qin Wujiu, I always thought you were a clever man. Unexpected..." He shook his head, a flicker of disappointment in his eyes, "You don't even understand what you're doing. Used as a gun by others, yet thinking yourself the chess player."

text.content: Qin Wujiu's expression finally changed. He wanted to retort, yet found all his rehearsed lines blocked in his throat. Chen Ji's words were like a precise scalpel,解剖ing and displaying his final remnants of pride to the world.

text.content: Chen Ji said nothing, merely gazing quietly at Qin Wujiu. His gaze was like an ancient well of unfathomable depth, calm, profound, utterly withoutfluctuation. Within this silence, Qin Wujiu's emotions gradually collapsed——first the arrogance dissolved, then came unease, finally transforming into an inexplicable fear. He couldn't endure this feeling of being completely seen through, as if his very soul had been stripped bare for display.

Qin Wujiu's smile gradually faded, replaced by a complex expression. He stared at Chen Ji, his eyes a spilled palette of emotions——discontent, fury, and a trace of something hard to detect... relief? "Aren't you the least bit curious?" He suddenly asked, his voice turning hoarse, "Curious why I betrayed you? Curious who came to me?"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji still said nothing, merely tilting his head slightly, making a posture of readiness to listen. Qin Wujiu gave a bitter laugh: "You calculated everything, didn't you? Rescuing me from the ruins, giving me everything, making me grateful... but have you ever considered——" His voice suddenly rose, "From the very beginning, I was merely a piece set on someone else's board?"

text.content: These words一出, Su Qingyao and Ye Qing's expressions simultaneously changed. Qin Wujiu's words hinted at an even deeper conspiracy——that the man Chen Ji carefully nurtured was from the start a hidden chess piece planted by the enemy. This wasn't merely a problem of betrayal, but that someone had been setting up this game from an even earlier time, intending to reduce all of Chen Ji's efforts to nothing. The temperature in the air seemed to drop several more degrees.

dialogue.content: "Speak." Chen Ji uttered a single word indifferently. He leaned against the wall, arms crossed, adopting a posture of attentive listening. Qin Wujiu drew a deep breath, a flash of madness in his eyes: "Three years ago, someone found me and gave me a token and a promise——he said that if I did as told, I could rescue my family in the Southern Frontier." His voice began to tremble, "I thought I was using you all... but in the end, it was still me being used."

text.content: Qin Wujiu's words revealed a startling piece of information——his family was held hostage. Three years ago was precisely when Chen Ji rescued him from the ruins. In other words, from that moment, someone was already exploiting Qin Wujiu's weakness to set up this chess game. This truth was more chilling than mere betrayal.

choices.description: Whatever his reasons, betrayal is betrayal, unworthy of sympathy
choices.risk_hint: The truth may be forever buried

dialogue.content: "Enough." Chen Ji cut him off, his voice icy, "Whatever your reasons, betrayal is betrayal." He raised his hand, a凌厉 sword qi condensing at his fingertips. Qin Wujiu's expression drastically changed, he struggled wanting to say something, but Chen Ji gave him no chance. The sword qi shot like a rainbow, piercing his heart instantly.

text.content: Blood gushed forth, staining the ground. Qin Wujiu's body slumped limply, but at the very last moment, the corners of his mouth actually formed a strange smile. That smile carried a解脱般的crazed, and using his final strength, he挤出 several words: "You don't know... the true enemy... was never within the Three Realms..." The voice abruptly ceased, his breath completely extinguished.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji didn't kill him, instead flicking arestriction rune into Qin Wujiu's body with a flick of his finger, sealing his cultivation. "Lock him in the heavenly prison, kept alone." His voice held nofluctuation, "Before he confesses all his accomplices, he is not allowed to die." Qin Wujiu's eyes went wide—he hadn't expected that what awaited him was not death, but the terrifyingly long interrogations worse than death.

text.content: Su Qingyao stepped forward, lowering her voice: "I will interrogate him personally. And——" She hesitated, "Do you truly believe what he said? About his family?" Chen Ji gave no answer, merely gazing at the bloodstains being dragged away with Qin Wujiu's body, a fleeting complex emotion flickering in the depths of his eyes.

Only heavy breathing remained in the dungeon. Qin Wujiu's parting words were like a thorn, lodged in everyone's heart. "The true enemy was never within the Three Realms"——what did this mean? Was it mere bluster, or some kind of hint? Ye Qing and Su Qingyao exchanged glances, both seeing the same doubt in each other's eyes. Chen Ji turned around, his back to them, his voice low: "Transmit my order—all persons connected within the Xuanwu, all to be detained for interrogation."

dialogue.content: "All?" Su Qingyao frowned, "The number implicated may exceed thirty, among them not a few core members. If we examine them one by one, the Xuanwu's operations will fall into paralysis." Chen Ji glanced back, his gaze calm yet firm: "Better to kill by mistake than to let one escape." His tone brooked no discussion, "Inform everyone—this is an extraordinary period, extraordinary measures. If anyone disagrees, you may leave now."

text.content: Su Qingyao fell silent for a moment, finally nodding and taking the order. Ye Qing gazed thoughtfully at Chen Ji's back, then suddenly spoke: "That Holy Sect token... I will continue investigating. This talk of beyond the Three Realms actually reminds me of some ancient legends." She paused, "In the records of the Ancient Forbidden Land, similar words have been mentioned." Chen Ji's footsteps略微一顿, but didn't look back.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing continued: "In ancient times, existences within the Forbidden Land once attempted to invade the Three Realms, and were jointly sealed by the cultivation world of that era. Legend says those existences' kin never disappeared, but lurked in the world in another form, biding their time." Her voice lowered, "If Qin Wujiu truly involves these... the situation may be far more serious than we imagined." Chen Ji finally turned around, his eyes deeper than the dungeon torches.

text.content: "Continue investigating." Chen Ji stated, his voice calm yet carrying undeniable authority, "Whatever lies behind this, since they dare stretch their hand into my chess game, they must be prepared to pay the price." He walked slowly toward the dungeon exit, showing no hesitation when passing Qin Wujiu's bloodstains. Su Qingyao and Ye Qing followed behind, their three shadows stretched long by the torches, intertwining on the dim walls.

The moment they stepped out of the dungeon, Chen Ji suddenly stopped. His hand reached into his breast pocket, fingertips touching that turtle shell fragment. The fragment was warming slightly, that sensation of resonance with a故人's aura appearing again——stronger than before, clearer. He raised his gaze toward the western suburbs of the imperial capital, where a familiar yet strange presence was approaching. He who comes with ill intent does not come peacefully; he who comes peacefully does not come with ill intent. And he, was already prepared to meet it.

The blood flowing from the traitor's mouth dyed the floor of the interrogation room crimson, yet his laughter grew increasingly mad——that laughter echoed in Chen Ji's ears, as if mocking the entire chess game of the mortal realm. The presence in the western suburbs drew ever nearer, Chen Ji gripped the turtle shell fragment tightly, his gaze cold and resolute as iron. Whether friend or foe approaches, in this game of chess, he had already prepared his next move.
